DejaVuSans.ttf — DejaVu Fonts
Bundled so the image-path redactor renders synthetic replacement text at the
correct (bounding-box-fitted) size. Without a TrueType font present, PIL falls
back to load_default() (a tiny fixed-size bitmap that ignores the requested
size), which made the replacement labels far too small.

DejaVu fonts are licensed under a permissive license (Bitstream Vera Fonts
Copyright + Arev derivative), free for any use including redistribution and
embedding. See: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html
